parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the time server.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Specifies in which mode the NTP server must be ran. {{enum}}

parameters.name: Version
parameters.description: Specifies the supported NTP version. Possible versions are 1-4.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: Specify the port used to receive NTP packets. {{bibref|RFC5905|Section 7.2}}

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: The IP Interface associated with the ''Server'' entry.

parameters.name: BindType
parameters.description: Specifies how the client sockets must be bounded. {{enum}}

parameters.name: MinPoll
parameters.description: This is the minimum polling interval, in {{units}} to the power of two, allowed by any peer of the Internet system, currently set to 6 (64 seconds). {{bibref|RFC5905|Section 7.2}}

parameters.name: MaxPoll
parameters.description: This is the maximum polling interval, in {{units}} to the power of two, allowed by any peer of the Internet system, currently set to 10 (1024 seconds) {{bibref|RFC5905|Section 7.2}}

parameters.name: TTL
parameters.description: Specifies the time to live (TTL) for a broadcast/multicast packet. {{bibref|RFC5905|Section 3.1}}

object.description: This object contains parameters relating to an time server instance.
